par.name: Parameters
par.statement:
@[local grind] structure Parameters where
  (N₀ d : ℕ)
  dvd_N₀ : 18480 ∣ N₀
  d_prime : d.Prime
  /-- `d ≡ N₀/2 - 1 mod N₀`. -/
  d_congr : N₀ ∣ 2 * (d + 1) ∧ ¬N₀ ∣ d + 1

dvdnorm.name: Parameters.dvd_norm_c₀
dvdnorm.statement: lemma dvd_norm_c₀ {s} (hp : p.Prime) (h : p ∣ P.N₁ s) : p ∣ (P.d + 1) / 4

chione.name: Parameters.chiK_eq_one_of_dvd
chione.statement: lemma chiK_eq_one_of_dvd {s} (hp : p.Prime) (h : p ∣ P.N₁ s) : chiK P.d p = 1

thirteen.name: Parameters.thirteen_le_of_chiK_ne_one
thirteen.statement: lemma thirteen_le_of_chiK_ne_one (hp : p.Prime) : chiK P.d p ≠ 1 → 13 ≤ p

NdM.name: Parameters.N₁_mul_d_dvd_M_omega
NdM.statement: lemma N₁_mul_d_dvd_M_omega {P s} : N₁ P s * P.d ∣ P.Mω s

powd.name: Parameters.pow_d_ne_neg_one
powd.statement: lemma Parameters.pow_d_ne_neg_one n : (P.d : ZMod P.N₀) ^ n ≠ -1

EP.name: Parameters.E
EP.statement: def E := CyclotomicField (P.N₁ s) P.K deriving Field, Algebra P.K, NumberField

rtu.name: Parameters.ζ
rtu.statement: def ζ := zeta (P.N₁ s) P.K (P.E s)

tocyc.name: Parameters.toCycloField
tocyc.statement:
def toCycloField {P s} : E P s →ₐ[ℚ] cycloField (P.N₁ s * P.d) :=
  have hζ := zeta_spec (P.N₁ s * _) ℚ (cycloField (P.N₁ s * P.d))
  let := (QuadField.nonempty_algHom_of_isPrimitiveRoot P.d (hζ.pow one_le rfl)).toAlgebra
  (SplittingField.lift _ (by simp [cyclotomic_eq_prod_X_sub_primitiveRoots (hζ.pow one_le
    (mul_comm ..))])).toRatAlgHom

embeq.name: Parameters.algHom_eq_of_mk_eq
embeq.statement: lemma algHom_eq_of_mk_eq {φ ψ : P.E s →ₐ[P.K] ℂ} (h : InfinitePlace.mk φ.1 = .mk ψ.1) : φ = ψ

galP.name: Parameters.galOfPlace
galP.statement: def galOfPlace : P.Φ s ≃* Gal(P.E s/P.K) := Equiv.mulEquiv _

pin.name: Parameters.placeOfInt
pin.statement: def placeOfInt ν := if h : IsUnit (Int.cast ν) then (P.placeMulEquiv s).symm h.unit else 1

pcl.name: Parameters.placeClass
pcl.statement: def placeClass {s m} (d : m ∣ P.N₁ s) := (ZMod.unitsMap d).comp (P.placeMulEquiv s).toMonoidHom

phialg.name: Parameters.phi_algebraMap
phialg.statement: @[simp] lemma phi_algebraMap v x : Φ v (algebraMap P.K (P.E s) x) = x

phimul.name: Parameters.phi_mul
phimul.statement: lemma Parameters.phi_mul v v' x : Φ (v * v') x = Φ v (P.galOfPlace s v' x)

galrt.name: Parameters.galOfPlace_zeta
galrt.statement:
lemma Parameters.galOfPlace_zeta v : P.galOfPlace s v (P.ζ s) =
  P.ζ s ^ (P.placeClass dvd_rfl v).1.val

pinpow.name: Parameters.placeOfInt_pow
pinpow.statement:
lemma Parameters.placeOfInt_pow i : P.placeOfInt s ν ^ i =
  P.placeOfInt s (ν ^ i)

clpin.name: Parameters.placeClass_placeOfInt
clpin.statement:
lemma Parameters.placeClass_placeOfInt (h : IsCoprime ν P.N₀) {m d} :
  (@placeClass P s m d (P.placeOfInt s ν)).1 = ν

galpin.name: Parameters.galOfPlace_placeOfInt_zeta
galpin.statement:
lemma Parameters.galOfPlace_placeOfInt_zeta (h : IsCoprime ν P.N₀) :
  P.galOfPlace s (P.placeOfInt s ν) (P.ζ s) = P.ζ s ^ ν

clneg.name: Parameters.placeClass_placeOfInt_eq_neg_one
clneg.statement:
@[simp] lemma Parameters.placeClass_placeOfInt_eq_neg_one d :
  @placeClass P s P.N₀ d (P.placeOfInt s ν) = -1 ↔ (ν : ZMod P.N₀) = -1

expandpow.name: Parameters.expand_pow_cyclotomic
expandpow.statement:
lemma Parameters.expand_pow_cyclotomic {p N} (h : p.Prime) (e : p ∣ N) k R [CommRing R] :
    expand R (p ^ k) (cyclotomic N R) = cyclotomic (N * p ^ k) R

expandtw.name: Parameters.expand_towerDeg_cyclotomic
expandtw.statement:
lemma Parameters.expand_towerDeg_cyclotomic : expand ℂ (towerDeg s) (cyclotomic P.N₀ ℂ) =
  cyclotomic (P.N₁ s) ℂ

cardPl.name: Parameters.card_infinitePlace_E
cardPl.statement:
lemma Parameters.card_infinitePlace_E s : numInfPlaces (P.E s) =
  towerDeg s * P.N₀.totient

cardcl.name: Parameters.card_placeClass_eq
cardcl.statement:
lemma Parameters.card_placeClass_eq d : #{v | @placeClass P s P.N₀ d v = 1} = towerDeg
  s

prm.name: Parameters.placePerm
prm.statement: def Parameters.placePerm {P} s (σ : Gal(ℂ/K P)) := Equiv.mulLeft (.mk (.comp σ (Φ 1)) : P.Φ s)

prmspec.name: Parameters.placePerm_spec
prmspec.statement: lemma Parameters.placePerm_spec {P s σ} v x : σ (Φ v x) = Φ (@placePerm P s σ v) x

roots.name: Parameters.exists_zeta_pow_eq
roots.statement: lemma Parameters.exists_zeta_pow_eq (h : IsOfFinOrder y) : ∃ k < P.N₁ s, ζ P s ^ k = y

prodphi.name: Parameters.prod_phi_eq_norm
prodphi.statement: lemma Parameters.prod_phi_eq_norm : ∏ v, Φ v y = Algebra.norm P.K y

rti.name: Parameters.zetaInt
rti.statement: abbrev zetaInt P s := (@isPrimitiveRoot_zeta P s).toInteger

czE.name: Parameters.c₀InE
czE.statement: abbrev c₀InE P s : 𝓞 (E P s) := c₀ P.d

sqd.name: Parameters.sqrtNegDInE
sqd.statement: def sqrtNegDInE P s := algebraMap _ (𝓞 (E P s)) (sqrtNegDInt P.d)

dgen.name: Parameters.relDifferentGen
dgen.statement: abbrev relDifferentGen P s := (cyclotomic (N₁ P s) _).derivative.eval (P.zetaInt s)

coert.name: Parameters.coe_zetaInt
coert.statement: @[simp] lemma coe_zetaInt : P.zetaInt s = P.ζ s

starrtpow.name: Parameters.star_zetaInt_pow_mul
starrtpow.statement: lemma star_zetaInt_pow_mul c : star (P.zetaInt s) ^ c * P.zetaInt s ^ c = 1

czmul.name: Parameters.c₀InE_mul_one_sub
czmul.statement: lemma c₀InE_mul_one_sub P s : c₀InE P s * (1 - P.c₀InE s) = ↑((P.d + 1) / 4)

starcz.name: Parameters.star_c₀InE
starcz.statement:
lemma star_c₀InE P s :
  star (c₀InE P s) = 1 - P.c₀InE s

relspec.name: Parameters.relDifferent_spec
relspec.statement:
lemma relDifferent_spec (hz :
  IsPrimitiveRoot z (P.N₁ s)) : let y

dgendvd.name: Parameters.relDifferentGen_dvd_N₁
dgendvd.statement: lemma relDifferentGen_dvd_N₁ : P.relDifferentGen s ∣ P.N₁ s

dgenne.name: Parameters.relDifferentGen_ne_zero
dgenne.statement:
@[simp↓] lemma relDifferentGen_ne_zero P s :
  (relDifferentGen P s).val ≠ 0

difmul.name: Parameters.different_eq_span_relDifferentGen_mul
difmul.statement:
lemma different_eq_span_relDifferentGen_mul : differentIdeal ℤ _ =
  span {P.relDifferentGen s * P.sqrtNegDInE s}

condmem.name: Parameters.cycloConductor_mem_different
condmem.statement: lemma cycloConductor_mem_different : ↑(P.N₁ s * P.d) ∈ differentIdeal ℤ (𝓞 (P.E s))

unitreal.name: Parameters.exists_unit_mul_relDifferentGen_real
unitreal.statement:
lemma exists_unit_mul_relDifferentGen_real : ∃ c, star c * c = 1 ∧ star (c * P.relDifferentGen s) =
  c * P.relDifferentGen s

vpi.name: Parameters.ϖ
vpi.statement:
def ϖ P s :=
  (@exists_unit_mul_relDifferentGen_real P s).choose * (P.relDifferentGen s * P.sqrtNegDInE s)

difvpi.name: Parameters.different_eq_span_varpi
difvpi.statement: lemma different_eq_span_varpi : differentIdeal ℤ _ = span {P.ϖ s}

prodvpi.name: Parameters.prod_varpi_eq_rootDiscr_pow
prodvpi.statement:
lemma prod_varpi_eq_rootDiscr_pow : ∏ v : P.Φ s, v (P.ϖ s).val =
  rootDiscr (P.E s) ^ numInfPlaces (P.E s)

absvpi.name: Parameters.infinitePlace_apply_varpi
absvpi.statement: lemma infinitePlace_apply_varpi (v : P.Φ s) : v (P.ϖ s).val = v (P.relDifferentGen s) * √P.d

galv.name: Parameters.galOfPlaceInt
galv.statement: noncomputable def galOfPlaceInt v := MulSemiringAction.toRingHom _ (𝓞 (P.E s)) (P.galOfPlace s v)

coegal.name: Parameters.coe_galOfPlaceInt
coegal.statement: @[simp] lemma coe_galOfPlaceInt x : galOfPlaceInt v x = P.galOfPlace s v x

memsmul.name: Parameters.mem_smul
memsmul.statement: @[simp] lemma mem_smul {x} : x ∈ (v • w).1 ↔ galOfPlaceInt v x ∈ w.1

Frb.name: Parameters.frobElem
Frb.statement: @[simp] noncomputable def frobElem (p : ℕ) := (P.placeOfInt n (chiK P.d p * p), chiK P.d p)

frobext.name: Parameters.frob_ext
frobext.statement:
lemma frob_ext : (∀ x, φ (galOfPlaceInt v x) = φ (c x) ^ p ^ n) ↔ φ (galOfPlaceInt v
  (P.zetaInt s)) = φ (galOfPlaceInt (P.placeOfInt s (e * p ^ n)) (P.zetaInt s)) ∧ chiK P.d p ^ n *
  e * φ (P.sqrtNegDInE s) = φ (P.sqrtNegDInE s)

binders.name: he
binders.type: c = RingEquiv.refl (𝓞 (P.E s)) ∧ e = 1 ∨ c = starRingAut ∧ e = -1

frobpow.name: Parameters.frob_iff_eq_frobElem_pow
frobpow.statement:
lemma frob_iff_eq_frobElem_pow [IsDomain R] : (∀ x, φ (galOfPlaceInt v x) = φ (c x) ^ p ^ n) ↔
  (v, e) = P.frobElem s p ^ n

binders.name: he
binders.type: c = RingEquiv.refl (𝓞 (P.E s)) ∧ e = 1 ∨ c = starRingAut ∧ e = -1

decomp.name: Parameters.smul_eq_iff_exists_frobElem_pow
decomp.statement:
lemma smul_eq_iff_exists_frobElem_pow : v • w = comap c c.surjective w ↔ ∃ n, (v, e) =
  P.frobElem s p ^ n

qpow.name: Parameters.q_eq_pow
qpow.statement: lemma q_eq_pow (hw : ↑p ∈ w.1) (hc : ¬p ∣ P.N₁ s * P.d) : w.q = p ^ orderOf (P.frobElem s p)

transit.name: Parameters.exists_smul_eq_or_star
transit.statement:
lemma exists_smul_eq_or_star (hw : ↑p ∈ w.1) (h : ↑p ∈ w'.1) : ∃ v : P.Φ s, v • w = w' ∨
  star (v • w) = w'

inertnd.name: Parameters.not_dvd_N₁_mul_d_of_inert
inertnd.statement: @[local simp] lemma not_dvd_N₁_mul_d_of_inert (hL : chiK P.d p = -1) : ¬p ∣ P.N₁ s * P.d

inertfix.name: Parameters.smul_eq_iff_inert
inertfix.statement: lemma smul_eq_iff_inert : v • w = w ↔ ∃ n, v = P.placeOfInt s (-p) ^ n ∧ Even n

inertstar.name: Parameters.smul_eq_star_iff_inert
inertstar.statement: lemma smul_eq_star_iff_inert : v • w = star w ↔ ∃ n, v = P.placeOfInt s (-p) ^ n ∧ Odd n

splitnd.name: Parameters.not_dvd_N₁_mul_d_of_modEq_one
splitnd.statement: @[local simp] lemma not_dvd_N₁_mul_d_of_modEq_one : ¬p ∣ P.N₁ s * P.d

splitne.name: Parameters.smul_ne_star
splitne.statement:
lemma smul_ne_star : v • w ≠ star
  w

splitfix.name: Parameters.smul_eq_self_iff_eq_one
splitfix.statement: lemma smul_eq_self_iff_eq_one : v • w = w ↔ v = 1

starmem.name: Parameters.star_mem_iff
starmem.statement: lemma star_mem_iff : star a ∈ w.1 ↔ a ∉ w.1

valnorm.name: Parameters.intValuation_eq_of_mul_star
valnorm.statement: lemma intValuation_eq_of_mul_star (k : a ∈ w.1) : w.intValuation a = .exp (-1)

bij.name: Parameters.nonempty_infinitePlace_equiv_finPlace
bij.statement:
lemma nonempty_infinitePlace_equiv_finPlace : Nonempty (P.Φ s ≃ {w : FinPlace _ // a ∈ w.1 ∧
  ↑p ∈ w.1})

valmap.name: Parameters.valuation_map_relDifferentGen
valmap.statement:
lemma Parameters.valuation_map_relDifferentGen (f : _ →+* 𝓞 (P.E s)) (h : (⇑f).Injective) (w :
  FinPlace (P.E s)) : w.valuation _ (f (P.relDifferentGen s)).val =
  w.valuation _ (P.relDifferentGen s).val

alP.name: Parameters.α

valpha.name: Parameters.v_alpha_mul_relDifferentGen
valpha.statement:
lemma Parameters.v_alpha_mul_relDifferentGen w :
  Valued.v ((P.α s * star (P.α s).1 * P.relDifferentGen s) w) = 1

Nal.name: Parameters.N₁_mul_α_mem
Nal.statement: lemma Parameters.N₁_mul_α_mem : P.N₁ s * (P.α s).1 ∈ Ô _
